canary-gitlab-mr-reporting.description: Use this skill when posting Canary result summaries to GitLab merge requests.
canary-gitlab-mr-reporting.body:
# Canary GitLab merge request reporting

## First actions

```console
canary query -c ext.gitlab.overview
canary query -c ext.gitlab.merge_request_reporter
```

## Reporter command

```console
canary report gitlab-mr
```

Optionally include a CDash link:

```console
canary report gitlab-mr --cdash-url URL
```

## Required environment

The reporter expects to run in GitLab CI with:

- `GITLAB_CI`
- `CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID`
- `CI_PROJECT_ID`
- `CI_API_V4_URL`
- `GITLAB_ACCESS_TOKEN` or `ACCESS_TOKEN`

## Behavior

- If jobs failed, the reporter posts a failed test summary table.
- If no jobs failed, the reporter posts a success note.
- If a CDash URL is provided, it is included in the note.
